enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Charisma +6: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +6 Insight bonus to Charisma.
Spell Focus Mastery +6: +6 Equipment bonus to the DC of all spells.
Spell Penetration +9: Passive: +9 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Magical Efficiency 10%: You take a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.

Mountainskin Set: While wearing both items from the Mountainskin Set, you gain:+30 Artifact bonus to Acid Spell Power+6% Artifact bonus to Acid Spell LoreWhen struck, you will occasionally have the Stoneskin spell cast on you.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
